name: propose_product
description: Propose an SMCyber insurance product structure for Indian SMEs. Call this first to establish the product-level parameters. The LLM only proposes; the deterministic gate decides compliance.

executionId.description: Existing execution ID. Omit on the first call; one is created automatically.

prompt.description: The original PM prompt (captured for traceability). Provide when executionId is absent.

line.description: Product line — always SMCyber for this hackathon.

aggregateLimitInr.description: Policy aggregate limit in INR. Must be between 500000 (₹5L) and 50000000 (₹5Cr).

turnoverInr.description: Insured enterprise annual turnover in INR. Must not exceed 2500000000 (₹250Cr).

minimumPremiumInr.description: Minimum premium floor in INR. Must be at least 10000 (₹10,000).

targetEffectiveDate.description: Proposed policy effective date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

proseSummary.description: Plain-language summary of the proposed product. Every monetary value mentioned must match a verified clause value exactly (required for the GROUNDING check).
